s12_f00e: Our nation has lost its beloved Premier to the traitor Yuri,
Fortunately, we still have a commander who leads our armies against the Allies,
a commander worthy of everyone's admiration.
General, I have retrieved Yuri's files.
He has left us a parting gift.
The Allies think we do not know about their Chronosphere in Alaska.
They intend to use it to launch an all-out attack.
These are their last remaining forces.
Wouldn't it be satisfying to crush their final hope?
Once you succeed, prepare to become Premier of the world.
s12_p01e: Comrade General, I must warn you.
The Allied Chronosphere could bring about our defeat.
Launch a swift naval attack first.
They will not expect our attack,
and that will be their downfall.
s13_f01e: People everywhere are congratulating the new Soviet Premier.
We now go live to London.
The people in the streets... this is a magnificent moment...
...we have not seen anything like this in decades.
The long-awaited new Premier has appeared in person...
General, if only I could see into your thoughts. I still have a chance...
